_comment: Explicit npm v1 release candidate set. Packages here must pass manifest, built-entry, dependency-closure, and registry-version checks before publish.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/core
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Parser, AST, traits, compilers, and runtime entrypoints for cold consumers.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/cli
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Installable holoscript/hs binary for users and agents.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/formatter
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Installable formatter library and holoscript-format binary for .holo, .hs, and .hsplus source hygiene.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/engine
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Reusable spatial engine runtime for rendering, physics, ECS, animation, GPU, and simulation consumers.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/framework
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Provider-neutral agent framework for board, behavior, economy, swarm, learning, and skill orchestration.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/absorb-service
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Installable Absorb and GraphRAG service package with public APIs kept separate from private knowledge stores.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/platform
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Installable HoloKey/x402-adjacent platform primitives for identity, access control, registry, Web3, contracts, and security policy consumers.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/mcp-server
candidatePackages.v1Intent: MCP server package for universal agent access to HoloScript.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/memory
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Installable client for the shared sovereign HoloScript agent-memory substrate required by MCP.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/agent-runtime
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Installable bounded agent turn/loop contract with caller-owned memory, authority, telemetry, receipts, and next-work adapters.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/holollama
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Installable HoloLlama utility package for planning llama.cpp serving nodes and emitting fleet registry artifacts.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/uaal
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Fleet-consumed uAAL semantic harness and portable uAA2++ VM primitives for agent cognition gates.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/domain-plugin-template
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Publishable template package required to keep @holoscript/core optional dependency closure installable.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/xr-embodiment
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Reusable VR/WebXR embodiment layer for users and agents in shared spatial worlds.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/agent-protocol
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Type-only uAA2++ agent protocol spec (interfaces, enums, PWG format) consumed by @holoscript/core and @holoscript/framework.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/llm-provider
candidatePackages.v1Intent: Unified LLM provider SDK (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, xAI, HoloServe/local adapters) consumed by @holoscript/core.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/snn-webgpu
candidatePackages.v1Intent: WebGPU compute library for spiking neural network simulation consumed by @holoscript/engine.

candidatePackages.name: @holoscript/holoembed
candidatePackages.v1Intent: 768-dim NL->code embedding service consumed by @holoscript/engine and the Absorb pipeline.
